title: Questions 186-190 refer to the following e-mails.
passage_1:
To:All Volunteers
From:Colette Ramsay
Date:February 3
Subject:Harbour Half

Dear Volunteers,

Thank you for joining the crew for this year’s Harbour Half. We are glad to have you! Please look over the volunteer duties below.

  • Duty 1 (Check-in): Hand out race numbers and kit bags.
  • Duty 2 (Course Marshalling): Direct runners at road junctions.
  • Duty 3 (Refreshments): Help prepare and pour drinks at the water stations.
  • Duty 4 (Timing Support): Assist officials with devices such as chip readers and lap clocks.

All volunteers must sign a nondisclosure agreement, since they may see runners’ personal records during the event. Also, please e-mail me your jacket size by February 4 at the latest, because I plan to order everyone’s crew jackets on February 5.

For those who have volunteered at four or more of our previous races, you are eligible to apply for a section leader post. Please send in your application by this Friday.

Best regards,
Colette Ramsay

To:Owen Beck <o.beck@rapidmail.com>
From:Colette Ramsay <c.ramsay@harbourhalf.org>
Date:February 6
Subject:Regarding your duty

Dear Mr. Beck,

I received your e-mail about your preferred station assignment. Please note that you are required to attend a briefing at 6:30 A.M. sharp on race day. The aim is to give you the information you will need to provide live support with electronic timing devices to the race officials.

If you cannot arrive by that hour, I am afraid I will have to move you to a different duty. Please tell me whether this schedule works for you.

Regards,
Colette

To:Colette Ramsay <c.ramsay@harbourhalf.org>
From:Owen Beck <o.beck@rapidmail.com>
Date:February 7
Subject:Re: Regarding your duty
Attachment:Application

Dear Ms. Ramsay,

Thank you for the update. I understand why the briefing matters. I live near the start line, so getting there by 6:30 A.M. will be no trouble at all.

I have also attached my application for the leadership post mentioned in your first e-mail. I believe my experience will be useful to the crew.

Best,
Owen
